copy_lock.copy:
This is the kind of love
I want us to grow into.

The date began with one missing key
and two suspects.

By the third wrong turn,
nobody was cute anymore.

“Don’t talk to me.”

He gave her the minute.
Not the distance.

It wasn’t really the wrong turn.

They had simply missed each other
for too many ordinary days.

The plan failed.
The date didn’t.

He still checked the lock twice.
She still rolled her eyes.

Then she went back
and checked it with him.

agents.prompt_summary: Extract visual mechanics from references without copying frames, likenesses, or exact labels.
Prove every locked slide through concrete Aachu/Zuv behavior, not decorative illustration.
Define wants, hidden needs, eye-lines, hands, posture, distance, and joke-to-tenderness movement.
Plan readable text and brandmark placement independently for every request-locked native output.
Translate the selected visual system into specific final-generation and integrated-text constraints.
Select one system only after scoring copy alignment, relationship proof, visual variety, identity, aspect safety, and sendability.

why_it_wins: Slide-Led Evidence Plan wins because it keeps the visual system accountable to the selected story arc.

slide_visual_blueprint.copy:
This is the kind of love
I want us to grow into.
slide_visual_blueprint.scene: Rain-damp evening beside a tiny roadside chai stall. Exactly Aachu and Zuv stand under one umbrella beside their modest dark car, safely parked on the quieter service lane away from traffic, dressed for a proper date. Across the divided road, through moving cars, the intended restaurant on the next road is visibly close but inconvenient to reach. The chai stall glows immediately beside them. Aachu points toward the chai stall with her right hand while her left hand stays relaxed at her side. Zuv holds the umbrella in his right hand and lowers the phone map in his left; they exchange a small conspiratorial 'shall we?' look. This is the decision before the accidental date, not the seated payoff. No chai vendor or background people visible.

slide_visual_blueprint.scene: Before departure, this nonlinear callback is entirely OUTSIDE the apartment in a pristine dry corridor. Medium-wide, nearly straight-on full-body view. Make the fully closed warm-brown wooden front door the dominant lower-frame object, spanning most of the composition from center-left to frame right. Its single exterior lever sits on the RIGHT edge beside Zuv. In the far-left background, small and partly cropped, the elevator doors are already 80 percent closed: only one narrow dark vertical seam, no open cabin or visible interior. Do not draw an elevator call button, wall switch, intercom, or metal wall plate anywhere near Aachu. Exactly two people stand on one depth plane, Zuv slightly taller and broader, with one forearm of clear air between their torsos. Zuv has stayed at the apartment door, square to it. His visible anatomical RIGHT hand wraps and depresses its exterior lever; his LEFT arm stays hidden behind his back. Aachu is the only person who turns back. Her left foot points toward the distant elevator, her lifted right heel steps back toward the apartment door, and three fading graphite ticks trace that return. Crucially, Aachu stands directly in front of the door's wooden center-left panel, not in the wall gap between elevator and door. Her visible anatomical RIGHT palm lands at least one handspan INSIDE the wooden door outline, with uninterrupted brown wood grain visible around every finger. Her elbow is locked straight and shoulder and torso weight drive a forceful push-test. Two short graphite compression strokes sit directly on the brown wood beside her palm. Her palm must never touch a lift button, call panel, wall plate, switch, intercom, hallway wall, or doorframe. Her left hand stays hidden by her shoulder tote and tightly rolled bone-dry umbrella. They do not touch, lean, hug, or overlap. Each looks at their own apartment-door contact, with a small private smile. Preserve attached-reference identity. Aachu: soft oval-round fuller-cheeked face, expressive dark eyes and brows, mostly straight center-parted dark hair, white shirt, blue jeans, red pointed flats; never a sharp narrow face or strong tousled waves. Zuv: broad rounded-oval face, thick brows, fuller trimmed beard and moustache, dense dark hair brushed up into broad swept waves, pale blue embroidered shirt, loose grey trousers, red-black shoes; never tight curls or ringlets. Everything is pristine and dry. Both participate in one apartment-door check through separate contacts: he tests the handle while she has gone back and pushes the wooden panel. No casual palm, key, fob, interior, open apartment door, open elevator cabin, lift-button touch, post-date return, wetness, folded or pocketed arms, solo checker, couple touch, arrows, ghost bodies, scooter, motorbike, or helmets.
slide_visual_blueprint.must_show: Visible Aachu/Zuv relationship behavior that proves the exact copy.
